correctness.rationale: The general-position sets are characterized exactly: without the hub every subset of the outer vertices is in general position, while a set containing the hub may use outer vertices from only one petal. This gives the displayed polynomial and coefficients. The symbolic proof then treats the exhaustive regimes \(m=1\), \(n=2,m\ge2\), and \(n\ge3,m\ge2\), controlling the only possible negative petal correction and the transition where that correction vanishes. A fresh finite sweep of the exact coefficient formula for \(2\le n\le30\), \(1\le m\le30\) found no failure; that experiment is only support for the all-parameter symbolic inequalities.
